notes: API discovered from Joyory JS bundle. beauty.joyory.com is the backend API host. No auth required for public product catalog.

categories._notes: Returns full category tree with subCategories. No auth required.

brands._notes: Returns array of {_id, name, slug, description, count}. count = product count.

promotions._notes: Returns array of promotion objects. section=offers for coupons/deals.

notes: Products use MongoDB _id as stable identifier.
Variants have images[] and shadeName (used for both shade names AND sizes like '50 ml').
howToUse is an array of strings.
ingredients is an array — may be full INCI list OR short marketing list (e.g. '10% Vitamin C').
avgRating=0 + totalRatings=0 means no reviews — not a bad rating.
Cart is fully client-side and auth-gated: no shareable cart URL exists.
Product page URL pattern: https://joyory.com/product/{slug} or /product/{slug}?variant={sku}
SKUs are NOT globally unique — same SKU number (e.g. 12) can appear on different products.
